note: Two warships whose sea-trial power and speed are transcribed from a published record. The set is deliberately tiny: it exists to pin the model's error against measured trials, not to fit anything.

cases.name: HMS Dreadnought (1906)
cases.source: Royal Navy trials, 9 October 1906, as transcribed by Wikipedia (HMS Dreadnought (1906))
cases.note: The 146-case reference set lists this hull at Cb 0.61; a form-derived Cb near 0.54 would give +7.7 % instead, so the block coefficient is itself a source of a couple of points.

cases.name: HMS Hood (1920)
cases.source: 1920 full-power trials, quoted as 'over 150,000 shp' by naval-encyclopedia; the figure is a lower bound so the recorded error is a lower bound too
